name: YOU NOT ME
source:
Moving at her own rhythm, Sora listens to her thoughts and observes the world. A pen for her mother’s drawing is today’s goal, yet even tiny errands can hold quiet stories rich with memories and little discoveries.

[From [url=https://zynkor.itch.io/you-not-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
空按照自己的节奏移动，聆听自己的想法并观察世界。今天的目标是为母亲画画准备一支笔，但即使是微小的差事也可以承载充满回忆和小发现的安静故事。

[来自[url=https://zynkor.itch.io/you-not-me]Itch.io[/url]]
